value.answer: Mostly it comes down to a steady routine. Start the same wind-down every time, like a diaper change, a quiet song, and lights low, so his body learns it means sleep. Put him down when he's drowsy, not fully asleep, so he learns to settle himself. Watch for tired signs like rubbing eyes or getting fussy, because a baby who gets overtired often fights sleep harder. How old is he? The tips shift a lot depending on age.
